predecessors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
predecessors.text: the undivided Frankish realm of 705-717, of which Neustria was the north-western part

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: Neustria after Charles Martel 'defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians' in 724, back inside the Frankish realm

rulers.name: Theuderic IV
rulers.title: puppet king of the reunited Frankish realm

ledger.x: 717: Charles Martel sets up Chlothar IV against Chilperic II, 'whose rule was thereby restricted to Neustria': 'the first time since 679 that the kingdom was divided'.
718: Charles defeats the Neustrian side at Soissons.
724: Charles Martel ends the Neustrian resistance.
724: Neustria is absorbed into the Frankish realm.

wars.name: Charles Martel's civil war against the Neustrians
wars.outcome: Charles installed Chlothar IV in 717 and defeated his rivals at Soissons in 718; the kingdom was reunited under Chilperic II in 718 but Charles Martel only 'defeated Ragenfrid and the rebellious Neustrians' in 724, 'ending the civil war phase of his rule'.

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary of Neustria; the outline is Cliopatria's and approximate throughout.
